additional_info.subject: RE: ID0439973-DC/Si-D/CH-[Y2/T5314324565001] Green LED from Chargepoint 3 CRM:02682000228
additional_info.body:
Hello Alexander,
Thank you for providing the picture. Since the LED is only partially lighting up, it seems likely that the LED itself is faulty ,first check the wiring for any loose connection if everthing is perfect then LED strip needs to be replaced. Please refer to the MLFB number below for ordering the Dispenser LED part and arranging the replacement.
